about: ADR-0108 §2, §4-§6 (AXI-01, #901). Golden cases for the axi/v1 contract (docs/axi/axi-v1.schema.json). axi-vectors.test.mjs holds the schema to these now: every accepted input validates, every allowed kind has an accepted case, and every Creatura line carries its raw stdout text with the source lines and commit it came from (that the raw text is real output is checked by re-running creatura.command at creatura.commit, not by the test). The C# codec, estimator, friction rules and StandardPolicy (AXI-02) and the TS codec check (AXI-06) are to read this same file, so they cannot drift. Codec: expect.result is accepted, refused, or batch (input is an array and expect.items gives each item's result: a refusal is for that item only, the rest of the batch is kept); reason is a code; http is set when it is not 400; duplicate:true means accepted and nothing new stored; effects:"trace-only" means the line goes into the session trace and changes no state (an agent's approval.* never answers a proposal: only the person does, through /answer; task.started, task.completed and task.handed-off are kept in the trace only, §4); an accepted line without effects is not trace-only; normalised is the line after intake (v set, detail and description discarded, at stamped with context.now when absent and rounded to the nearest second, half up; tenant, app, actor and roles are stamped by the server and not shown). An agent outcome needs a proposalId whose context.proposals state is accepted; accepted is then taken from that state, and reported keeps only context.reportedKeys plus agentConfirmed and suggested. The goal is checked before the proposal. Proximity: counts are what the caller can read per anyOf entry; done = best entry's min(count/atLeast, 1); proximity = Σ weight·done ÷ Σ weight; complete = every milestone of weight > 0 is done. Friction: see context.weights; a rule fires when its count reaches the threshold inside its window ending at context.now (validation.repeated: same rule on the same field ≥ 3 in 5 min; action.repeated ≥ 3 in 5 min; view.loop: 3 A→B→A cycles in 2 min; workflow.restarted: ≥ 2 restarts of the same workflow in 10 min), saturation 1 when fired, score = min(1, Σ weight × saturation); agent signals only count against that capability, per proposal (capabilitySignals: capability → correlationId → count; a candidate's agentSignals: proposal id → count, ≥ 2 on one proposal starts the cooldown). Plans: utility = Σ weight × term with the weights in context.weights (keys outside progressGain, usefulness, friction, repetition are refused); scores compare to 1e-9; candidates lists the eligible ones by score, at most one commercial; cooldowns are 30 min after shown and 24 h after dismissed. Refusal codes, one scheme in both codecs: type.unknown (not an object, or an unknown type); envelope.<key> when a line's own field fails the schema (unknown key, v, eventId, correlationId, sessionId, at, tick, simulated, goalId, detail, description, capabilityId, requiresConfirmation, status, accepted, confirmed, reported, an outcome's proposalId); props.<prop> for a prop; kind.unknown, simulated.not-lab-tenant, capability.unknown, goal.unknown for the app's facts; outcome.no-proposal, proposal.unknown (409: not in this tenant and app), proposal.not-accepted (409: not accepted, or made for another goal), proposal.singular-only. They are checked in that order: type, the envelope, kind, lab tenant, capability, goal, then the line type's own fields, then the proposal. The C# codec alone also refuses a line its JSON model cannot read (duplicate keys) as shape.invalid. Setup parity (AXI-22, #923): each kit SetupStep is a milestone {id: key, weight: weight ?? 1, anyOf: [{collection: "setup", key, atLeast: 1}]} with count 1 when done, else 0; the kit's progressOf(steps).proximity and the C# WeightedMilestoneEstimator's proximity both equal expect.proximity (compared to 1e-9). optional does not change proximity (it counts, as in done / total); Σ weight is always > 0 here, since the estimator refuses a goal without weight (checkSetup refuses the same list). The C# side declares the goal as JSON and runs it through AxiGoals.Parse, so a step key must be a milestone id. Only proximity is shared: the kit's finished reads optional, the server's complete reads weight > 0 or the goal's completion list. A case with previousProximity also checks that proximity went down.

a leap second (the schema allows :60) reads as the next second

proximity.name: fractional: profile done, half of a two-post milestone
anyOf takes the best entry, not the sum
regressing: recomputed from data, so it goes backwards when a friendship is removed
order is not assumed: a post before a profile counts
a zero-weight milestone adds nothing and does not block completion

setupParity.name: no weights: proximity is done / total
no weights: an optional step counts like done / total does
regressing: a step undone again lowers it

friction.name: same rule on the same field fails 3 times in 5 min: fires
the same rule fails twice: just below, nothing
three failures, the first outside 5 min: below
same action fails 3 times in 5 min: fires
view loop A→B→A three cycles in 2 min: fires
workflow restarted twice in 10 min (three starts, none completed): fires
two rules at threshold add up
inactivity adds nothing: one view, then 30 min of silence
agent signals never add to the person's friction (tool.lied, tool.failed, approval.rejected, task.cancelled)

plan.name: friction at the threshold, goal unmet: the best candidate is selected
only commercial candidates left: empty, never the only offer
at most one commercial candidate per plan: the second is dropped
candidates in cooldown (shown 10 min ago) or dismissed (2 h ago): empty
cooldown over (shown 31 min ago, dismissed 25 h ago): eligible again
agent-signal cooldown: two agent failures on this proposal drop the capability
a writing capability waits for ADR-0107: dropped
an unknown policy id: empty, never another policy
an engagement weight key is refused
a staytime weight key is refused
